name: glow-columns
title: Glow Columns
description: An index through the day: thin stems grow under bright caps in turn, low periods sitting as green dots.

perf.budget: Stems and caps use short UI-thread springs on arrival. Nothing animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Columns appear in place and the number does not count.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { GlowColumns } from '@/components/kinetik/glow-columns';

<GlowColumns
  values={[0, 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 8, 7, 5, 3, 2, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0]}
  current={5}
  max={10}
  level="MODERATE"
  name="UVI"
  labels={['12', '14', '16', '18', '20', '22']}
/>;
```

## When to use

- Sun, pollen or air index through a day.
- Any level where low, medium and high carry the meaning.

## When not to use

- Exact values per period: only the current one is written out.
- Colour alone cannot carry the meaning: keep `level` on.

## Notes

- Below 30% of the scale is green, below 70% yellow, and orange above.
- `current` sets the big number and brightens that column's rail.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add glow-columns`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
